tools.name: get_publication_requirements
tools.description: Explains New York's LLC publication requirement: LLC Law §206 for New York LLCs, §802 for out-of-state (foreign) LLCs registered in New York, and §1203 for PLLCs. Covers the two newspapers, six weeks, the 120-day deadline, the Certificate of Publication and what happens if it is missed.

tools.name: get_county_publication_cost
tools.description: FileMyPublication's all-in price to complete New York LLC publication in a county (both newspapers for six weeks, the State filing fee and our service fee) and the newspapers designated there. In Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens and the Bronx the County Clerk assigns the papers, so the price is quoted on

tools.name: calculate_publication_deadline
tools.description: Calculates a New York LLC's publication deadline: 120 days from the date its Articles of Organization were filed (or, for a foreign LLC, from when its Application for Authority took effect). Returns the date and the days remaining.

tools.name: get_county_clerk
tools.description: The County Clerk's office for a New York county: phone, address, hours, email and website. The Clerk designates the newspapers an LLC must publish in.

tools.name: draft_publication_notice
tools.description: Drafts the legal notice text a New York LLC publishes (§206), a foreign LLC's Notice of Qualification (§802), or a PLLC's notice (§1203), from the LLC's details. Anything not given prints as a bracketed placeholder. Uses the same wording the FileMyPublication site generates.

tools.name: list_llc_services
tools.description: FileMyPublication's New York LLC services with their all-in prices: LLC publication, filing the Certificate of Publication, Certificate of Change, Articles of Dissolution and a certified copy of the Articles of Organization.

tools.name: start_order
tools.description: Returns the link to start an order with FileMyPublication for a service, prefilled with the county and the LLC's DOS ID when given. It never places an order: the person reviews the price and pays on the website.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Finds FileMyPublication's plain-English guides on New York LLC publication by topic, e.g. 'missed deadline', 'affidavit', 'Brooklyn cost', 'foreign LLC', 'single member home address'. Returns titles, summaries and links.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_county_clerk · Public sink: get_county_clerk.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_county_clerk · Public sink: get_county_clerk

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
